collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SLK Class 2011 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz SLK Class Roadster 2011 to 2016 (R172) model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment.
